self_serve.quote: Create an external client app in a Salesforce org, enable OAuth, and configure an OAuth flow.
self_serve.reason: Access requires a Developer Edition org plus app setup, so not instant; no source cleanly establishes a single self-serve tier.

mcp_status.quote: Salesforce Hosted MCP Servers give AI agents a secure, governed way to interact with Salesforce data and automation.
mcp_status.reason: Salesforce's own developer docs describe a first-party hosted MCP server.

verdict.quote: Creating connected apps is restricted as of Spring ‘26.
verdict.reason: Integration needs an org and an external client app with OAuth; connected-app creation is restricted, so access is conditional.
